column1: # Crates scripts/check_semver.sh must NOT gate (issue #5050).
# The gate protects LIBRARY consumers: a dependent that re-resolves a `^0.y` or
# `^x.y` floor on a lockfile-free `cargo install` and stops compiling. That is
# #4088 — trusty-common 0.22.5 added a required public field on a patch bump and
# cost trusty-analyze 0.7.3 a yank — and trusty-common has 17 in-repo consumers,
# so every one of them was exposed.
# A crate with NO library consumer has nobody to protect. Its users install a
# binary, and a binary user gets a whole new executable on every `cargo install`;
# the library API it happens to expose is not part of what they consume.
# EVERY ROW IS A COVERAGE HOLE AND HAS TO EARN ITS PLACE. An excluded crate's
# public API is never compared against the registry, so the row must name a
# reason that is a FACT about how the crate is consumed, not a preference. "It
# is slow", "it always fails", and "we are mid-refactor" are not reasons.
# THE ROW RESTS ON AN ASSUMPTION, AND THE GATE RE-CHECKS IT ON EVERY RUN.
# Before granting the skip, check_semver.sh asks `cargo metadata` whether any
# workspace package declares a dependency on the excluded crate. One does and
# the skip is REFUSED: the run exits 3 (no verdict) naming the dependent, so the
# day the premise dies the publish stops instead of quietly proceeding
# unprotected. What it cannot see is an out-of-repo consumer on crates.io — that
# one is a stated assumption, re-checkable with
#   curl -s https://crates.io/api/v1/crates/<crate>/reverse_dependencies
# Format (tab-separated):  <crate>
# <crate> is the package name (`tga`), not the crates/ directory name.
# <crate>
# #8341: the `trusty-mpm` row is REMOVED, not commented out, for the same
# reason the `tga` row below is. It claimed zero workspace packages depend on
# trusty-mpm's library; #8341 gave the new test-only `trusty-crate-contracts`
# crate a NORMAL `trusty-mpm` dependency, so that the cross-gate test it hosts
# stops costing trusty-mpm a `[dev-dependencies]` edge on trusty-review. The
# gate re-checked the premise, found the dependent, and refused the skip with
# exit 3 on every trusty-mpm run. The claim is dead, and trusty-mpm is gated
# like any other crate now. Do not re-add the row while that edge exists.
# #6300: the `tga` row is REMOVED, not commented out. It claimed zero workspace
# packages depend on tga's library; #6294 gave trusty-analyze a `tga` Cargo edge,
# so the gate refused the skip and exited 3 on every tga run. The claim is dead,
# and tga is gated like any other crate now. Do not re-add the row while that
# edge exists — the gate re-checks the premise and will refuse again.
